title.narrative: Resilient Futures: Protection and Education for Children and Youth in Northeast Syria ¿ Phase III

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to increase the resilience and well-being of vulnerable children, youth and caregivers in three governorates of North East Syria (NES)- Deir-ez-Zor, Ar-Raqqa and Al-Hasakeh- through the provision of quality education, psychosocial and livelihoods support and child protection services, accompanied by efforts to promote the rights and well-being of children in detention and/or associated with armed groups.

The Action will have four specific objectives/outcomes focused on protection, social cohesion & resilience, education, and support to CAAFAG. The proposed integrated approach will provide a comprehensive response to vulnerable children and their families, thus reducing the risk of radicalisation and recruitment by armed groups, as well as supporting meaningful reintegration. The four specific objectives/outcomes the Action will achieve are as follows:

1. To protect vulnerable children in NES from violence, exploitation, abuse and neglect;

2. To improve the resilience of vulnerable children, youth and their caregivers in NES and increase community-level social cohesion;

3. To improve access to education in safe learning spaces for vulnerable children in NES;

4. To protect Children Associated with Armed Forces and Armed Groups (CAAFAG) from further harm, improve their well-being and have viable pathways for reintegration or repatriation.
